segments.title: the self upon the heaps

spans.eng: about the heaps, the various components to yourself
when you get the idea of "me"

spans.tib: snga phyi'i rgyun gyi tshogs pa
spans.eng: as a whole, when you consider them as a continuum in time
as a whole considered in a single moment in time
as the various parts to a whole
that you could ever establish as being any kind of "me"
We'll go into this in more detail further on.

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment by Codex, English-first proposal, 2026-09-12.
